Where to Find Today’s Firefly Deals

Firefly publishes its offers on its own channels. These are the live sources, and they will always be more current than any list this page could keep.

Official source What you will find there
Firefly deals page Firefly’s own list of current deals, destination offers and add-on bundles.
Firefly website Live fares for your dates and route. This is the price you will actually pay.
Travel add-ons Seats, extra baggage and the FlySmarter bundle, priced before you check out.
Media centre Firefly’s announcements, including  travel advisories and route news.
Facebook page Firefly’s own page. Short-notice fare drops and route news are often posted here before the website is updated.

This page does not quote live fares. Firefly changes its promotional windows every few weeks, and a fare copied here would be out of date within days.

How Firefly Deals Work

Campaign names change, but the mechanics do not. This section stays accurate between sales.

Question What to expect
Where does Firefly fly from? Most routes leave from Subang (SZB) or Penang, with some from Kota Kinabalu and KLIA. Check the departure airport before comparing fares.
Why are Firefly fares often lower? Many routes use turboprop aircraft on shorter sectors. That keeps operating costs down, and part of the saving reaches the fare.
What is the FlySmarter bundle? A paid add-on that bundles a preferred seat with extra checked baggage. It is usually cheaper than buying the two separately.
Is baggage included? Firefly fares are generally cabin-baggage only. Checked baggage is an add-on, and the allowance depends on the fare you pick.
Are the campaigns below still bookable? No. They are kept as a record of the kinds of offers Firefly runs. Use the official links above for a fare you can book today.

Firefly Promotions: Frequently Asked Questions

Is this page updated automatically?

Partly. The current-offers block above is rebuilt from Firefly’s own deals page every week. The campaign archive below is a historical record and is not updated.

Book Flights

Where do I find the promotion that is running now?

Open the Firefly deals page, or check the booking site directly. A sale is normally announced on those channels before it opens.

Can I still book a fare shown in the archive below?

No. Those campaigns were recorded earlier and their booking windows have closed. They are kept as a record of the kinds of offers Firefly runs.

Book Flights

Do Firefly promotions apply to all routes?

No. Most campaigns cover a named set of routes, and some exclude the turboprop sectors. The terms of each offer list exactly what is included.
